header: Where the figures above this band come from
text: The companion to every other element in this group. Each figure in a data band is typed by an editor rather than measured by anything, and this is the band where the editor says on what basis: what period, which population, what method, whose source.
cta_label: Link to the full data set
note: Say who maintains the figures and how corrections are handled. A method box that never mentions revisions implies there have never been any.
